hub.speaker: Ksmvr
hub.text: I am Ksmvr. I am a member of the Horns of Hammerad. There are four of us. Four is a better number than three, because it divides. The fourth is the [Necromancer] who reads our doors, and he maintains he is hired rather than ours, on the grounds that he invoices us. Captain Ceria has ruled that he is a teammate who invoices. I have written down both positions.

text_variants.text: The construct was very large. I stabbed it anyway. Captain Ceria says this is called 'initiative.'
